coldOpen: Why tap water sickened 403,000 people in Milwaukee.
centralDependencyQuestion: How did a parasite slip through a city's water treatment and sicken 403,000 people?

evidence.claim: The 1993 Milwaukee cryptosporidiosis outbreak was the largest waterborne disease outbreak in documented United States history.
Approximately 403,000 residents were affected, and 4,400 were hospitalized.
The total cost of the outbreak, in productivity loss and medical expenses, was $96 million.
Schools had to throw away 68,000 servings of Jell-O due to the possibility that it was contaminated.
